moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio highlight-sweep, written here): On the updated row only (clipped to it): a 32 px soft white band, skewX −18°, crosses from −65 % to +115 % of the row width (the recipe's −130 % → 230 %, halved in the demo) in 820 ms power2.inOut, opacity 0.75·sin(π p), peak mid-way; once. The row itself is pre-styled as updated (light fill, accent border). Params: duration (0.82 s) · width: bề rộng vệt (32 px) · skew (−18°) · opacity đỉnh (0.75).
